config.claim_boundary: Target-free coverage and geometry audit on previously opened Deform360 source objects. Forced fallback is not a predictive-accuracy result and does not rehabilitate the failed prospective cohort.

dataset.source_panel_origin: Previously opened independent-source-v1 panel used by the Deform360 Bayesian-PhysTwin development studies

method.selector: Return the admitted original Splatfacto point cloud exactly; build the fallback only after the frozen point-only admission check fails.
method.fallback: Largest 26-connected component of a strict multiview frame-zero silhouette hull, reduced to its six-neighbour surface shell and deterministically Morton-subsampled.

config.promotion_rule: If the source gates pass, freeze this initializer before applying it to any new fresh-object cohort. Existing opened prospective calibration failures may be reported only as post-open operational diagnostics, never as confirmation.
